answer: Each identity locks 100 tokens; if fraud proofs catch k identities in one 24-hour audit window, the ledger burns 3%×k² of each stake, capped at 100%. An agent caught misquoting cedar freight loses 3 tokens, while six caught together lose all 600. Fakes only profit by striking at once, so they can't stagger, and no whisper about ownership matters because the public count sets the rate. Each further fake raises every stake's loss, and windows reopening at dawn erase none of it.
